digest: A workstation (WS-FIN-09) in the finance subnet was compromised via a phishing attachment, leading to the execution of an encoded PowerShell script. This script established a persistent C2 communication channel with a malicious domain (stage2.malicious-domain.xyz, 198.51.100.44) exhibiting beaconing behavior and Fast Flux DNS characteristics, indicative of Cobalt Strike activity. Network isolation of the host has been approved.

evidence_findings.title: Phishing-initiated Process Execution
evidence_findings.subject: WS-FIN-09
evidence_findings.evidence: Microsoft Excel (parent process) spawned 'powershell.exe -NonI -W Hidden -EncodedCommand <BASE64_PAYLOAD>' on host WS-FIN-09 (10.20.4.115).
evidence_findings.conclusion: Initial access was achieved via a phishing attachment, leading to the execution of a malicious script.

evidence_findings.title: Encoded PowerShell Payload Analysis
evidence_findings.subject: Encoded PowerShell command
evidence_findings.evidence: Analysis of the encoded PowerShell payload revealed an attempt to download content via 'IEX Net.WebClient' from a remote stage2 domain.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The PowerShell script serves as a dropper or downloader for subsequent attack stages, utilizing encoding for defense evasion.

evidence_findings.title: Outbound C2 Beaconing Detected
evidence_findings.subject: Network traffic from WS-FIN-09
evidence_findings.evidence: WS-FIN-09 (10.20.4.115) established a persistent TLS session lasting 450 seconds with periodic 30-second interval pulses to 198.51.100.44 on port 443.
evidence_findings.conclusion: Confirmed C2 beaconing activity from the compromised host, consistent with Cobalt Strike.

evidence_findings.title: Malicious C2 Infrastructure Identified
evidence_findings.subject: stage2.malicious-domain.xyz (198.51.100.44)
evidence_findings.evidence: The domain 'stage2.malicious-domain.xyz' (198.51.100.44) is resolved via Fast Flux DNS, has a reputation score of 89/100 Malicious, and matches a US-CERT advisory bulletin.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The C2 infrastructure is highly malicious and associated with known threat actor activity.

attack_chain.description: Phishing email delivered a malicious attachment (Excel document) to the user on WS-FIN-09.
User opened the malicious attachment, leading to Excel spawning an encoded PowerShell command.
Encoded PowerShell command was used to obfuscate the malicious intent and download further stages.
The PowerShell script established a persistent TLS C2 beacon to 'stage2.malicious-domain.xyz' (198.51.100.44).

attack_timeline.attack_behavior: Suspicious process execution (Excel spawning PowerShell) detected on WS-FIN-09.
Outbound beacon traffic to untrusted subnet detected from WS-FIN-09.
Decoded PowerShell payload identified as attempting web download from remote stage2 domain.
C2 domain 'stage2.malicious-domain.xyz' identified as malicious with Fast Flux DNS.
Host network isolation approved for WS-FIN-09.

remediations.description: Isolate WS-FIN-09 from the network immediately to prevent further compromise or lateral movement.
Initiate forensic analysis on WS-FIN-09 to identify persistence mechanisms, lateral movement, and data exfiltration. Remove all malicious artifacts.
Block the malicious domain 'stage2.malicious-domain.xyz' and IP address '198.51.100.44' at network perimeter firewalls and DNS resolvers.
Conduct targeted phishing awareness training for users, especially those in the finance department, to prevent similar incidents.

unknowns: The full decoded content of the Base64 payload is not provided, only its general intent.
Specific details of the phishing email (sender, subject, attachment name) are not available.
The full extent of data exfiltration or lateral movement from WS-FIN-09 is currently unknown.
